purpose: Store only independently timestamped candidate substantive evidence points for rolling P0 coverage. This ledger does not itself promote intervals to useful coverage.
promotion_rule: A point is eligible only when the referenced change is materially substantive under control/evidence-policy.v1.json. Coverage between points is not inferred automatically; a completed window auditor must classify every interval and boundary.

points.basis: Materially changes scheduler conflict resolution by fencing retired fixed-quarter semantics.
Makes rolling errata mandatory on fresh wakes and therefore operationally enforceable.
Advances live P0 interpretation to epoch 24 and explicitly prevents control cleanup from being miscounted as an accepted rolling window.

note: Commit timestamps were read from GitHub commit metadata. Scheduler mutation time is not treated as substantive useful-work evidence by itself.
